title: Scientific multi-agent reinforcement learning for wall-models of turbulent flows
summary: SciMARL uses cooperating agents to learn LES wall models that reproduce turbulent-flow quantities at substantially lower computational cost and generalize to unseen geometries and Reynolds numbers; this is a specific computational-physics result.
